column1: # Provisional game profile (generated by scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py from the survey with dm/games/profile_guess.py, not checked by hand)
# Mario Kart World 1.0.0 (base game, dumped folder packed by scripts/pack_dump.py). Adapted from the 1.8.0 profile of an outside patch series; 1.8.0 also has subsdk1
# .img: the RomFS image, when switch2mac.py ios --romfs packs it into the IPA (23 GB of mostly zstd files, which deflate would not shrink)

# the NPDM declares 64 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap: a 5 GB block with a large alias region; the heap check sizes the heap region from the heap the game asks for
# the NPDM declares 64 MB of system resource
# The terrain height tiles (260x260 R16 format 0x6, 68x68 format 0x2a, MINIMAL_LAYOUT, no packaged layout) are filled by the CPU in place: their guest storage holds the heights while
# the host textures stayed all zeros, so the ground lay flat at height 0 (fog-coloured planes in hard rectangles, invisible roads)
